sections.title: The degree of the tetrahedron index
sections.extract: []{#sub.degI label="sub.degI"} The (minimum) degree $\delta(m,e)$ with respect to $q$ of $I_{\Delta}(m,e)$ is given by $$\label{eq.degID} \delta(m,e) = \frac{1}{2}\left( m_+(m+e)_+ + (-m)_+ e_+ + (-e)_+(-e-m)_+ +\max\{0,m,-e\} \right)$$ It follows that $\delta(m,e)$ is a piecewise quadratic polynomial shown in Figure [1](#degI){reference-type="ref" reference="degI"}.

sections.title: Subdivisions of the Epstein–Penner decomposition
sections.extract: For a once-cusped hyperbolic 3--manifold $M$, the Epstein--Penner decomposition (see [@EP]) divides $M$ into a finite number of ideal hyperbolic polyhedra. sections.extract: The concept of a regular triangulation comes from the study of triangulations of convex polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^n$.
